name: travel-a2ui
description: A travel planner whose agent answers in A2UI: the model composes every surface, rendered by React and Flutter from the same messages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/renderer && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/web
scripts.e2e: node tools/e2e/chat.mjs && node tools/e2e/interaction.mjs && node tools/e2e/frameworks.mjs && node tools/e2e/keys.mjs && node tools/e2e/sample.mjs
scripts.generate: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py && python3 scripts/build_skills.py && python3 scripts/build_catalog_reference.py && python3 scripts/build_fixtures.py
scripts.check: npm run check:catalog && npm run check:skills && npm run check:reference && npm run check:fixtures
scripts.screenshots: node tools/e2e/chat.mjs --screenshot docs/screenshots/01-chat-light.png && node tools/screenshots/capture.mjs docs/screenshots
